```python
class Inventory:
    def __init__(self):
        self._counts = {}

    def add(self, name, count):
        if count < 0:
            raise ValueError("count must be nonnegative")
        self._counts[name] = self._counts.get(name, 0) + count

    def total(self):
        return sum(self._counts.values())
```
